newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines warns ships of typhoon.
newsitem.headline: Philippines warns ships of typhoon.

text.p: Tropical storm Beth has intensified into a typhoon, threatening the central and northern Philippine Luzon island, the government weather bureau said on Thursday.

Beth, with maximum sustained winds of 120 kph (75 miles per hour) near the centre and gusts of up to 150 kph (93.75 miles per hour), was estimated at 210 kms (131.25 miles) east of Tuguegarao, Cagayan.
The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronimical Services Administration said coastal waters will be "very rough and dangerous" to all kinds of ships in northern Luzon area.
"Coastal residents are advised not to venture out into the sea due to big waves generated by this typhoon," the weather bureau said in an advisory.
